bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea in Hampshire in the stunning surroundings of this grand country house. Set in the New Forest National Park in 40 acres of private grounds, Afternoon Tea at Rhinefield House is perfectly accompanied by a stroll around the beautiful gardens.  Afternoon Tea at Rhinefield House Hotel is served in the Lounge Bar, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. This elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Rhinefield House are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
